reason: The free trial is fine to try, but I don't know if it reads my K PLUS slips or my card statement properly, and the only banks listed are K PLUS, Bangkok Bank and TTB. I already quit one budget app after a few weeks, so I would not pay until I've seen it work on my own slips for the full 14 days.
objection: Will it even read my bank and my card, and do I want my money data stored in someone's database even if it is encrypted?
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it correctly read three or four of my own real K PLUS slips and a real card statement during the free trial, with my bank clearly supported.
